name: Gan Zhao, PhD
bio: Principal Investigator at the School of Medicine, Xiamen University, with a joint appointment at the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University. Research focuses on lung injury and regeneration, pulmonary vascular biology and cellular interactions.
bio_zh: 厦门大学医学院课题组负责人，兼任厦门大学附属第一医院科研岗位。聚焦肺损伤与再生、肺血管生物学及细胞互作。
